vulg: Paulus et Timotheus servi Iesu Christi omnibus sanctis in Christo Iesu qui sunt Philippis cum episcopis et diaconis
clem: Paulus et Timotheus, servi Jesu Christi, omnibus sanctis in Christo Jesu, qui sunt Philippis, cum episcopis et diaconibus.
tr: παυλος και τιμοθεος δουλοι ιησου χριστου πασιν τοις αγιοις εν χριστω ιησου τοις ουσιν εν φιλιπποις συν επισκοποις και διακονοις
kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

vulg: gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre nostro et Domino Iesu Christo
clem: Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: gratias ago Deo meo in omni memoria vestri
clem: Gratias ago Deo meo in omni memoria vestri,
tr: ευχαριστω τω θεω μου επι παση τη μνεια υμων
kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

vulg: semper in cunctis orationibus meis pro omnibus vobis cum gaudio deprecationem faciens
clem: semper in cunctis orationibus meis pro omnibus vobis, cum gaudio deprecationem faciens,
tr: παντοτε εν παση δεησει μου υπερ παντων υμων μετα χαρας την δεησιν ποιουμενος
kjv: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

vulg: super communicatione vestra in evangelio a prima die usque nunc
clem: super communicatione vestra in Evangelio Christi a prima die usque nunc.
tr: επι τη κοινωνια υμων εις το ευαγγελιον απο πρωτης ημερας αχρι του νυν
kjv: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

vulg: confidens hoc ipsum quia qui coepit in vobis opus bonum perficiet usque in diem Christi Iesu
clem: Confidens hoc ipsum, quia qui cpit in vobis opus bonum, perficiet usque in diem Christi Jesu:
tr: πεποιθως αυτο τουτο οτι ο εναρξαμενος εν υμιν εργον αγαθον επιτελεσει αχρις ημερας ιησου χριστου
kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

vulg: sicut est mihi iustum hoc sentire pro omnibus vobis eo quod habeam in corde vos et in vinculis meis et in defensione et confirmatione evangelii socios gaudii mei omnes vos esse
clem: sicut est mihi justum hoc sentire pro omnibus vobis: eo quod habeam vos in corde, et in vinculis meis, et in defensione, et confirmatione Evangelii, socios gaudii mei omnes vos esse.
tr: καθως εστιν δικαιον εμοι τουτο φρονειν υπερ παντων υμων δια το εχειν με εν τη καρδια υμας εν τε τοις δεσμοις μου και τη απολογια και βεβαιωσει του ευαγγελιου συγκοινωνους μου της χαριτος παντας υμας οντας
kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

vulg: testis enim mihi est Deus quomodo cupiam omnes vos in visceribus Christi Iesu
clem: Testis enim mihi est Deus, quomodo cupiam omnes vos in visceribus Jesu Christi.
tr: μαρτυς γαρ μου εστιν ο θεος ως επιποθω παντας υμας εν σπλαγχνοις ιησου χριστου
kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

vulg: et hoc oro ut caritas vestra magis ac magis abundet in scientia et omni sensu
clem: Et hoc oro, ut caritas vestra magis ac magis abundet in scientia, et in omni sensu:
tr: και τουτο προσευχομαι ινα η αγαπη υμων ετι μαλλον και μαλλον περισσευη εν επιγνωσει και παση αισθησει
kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

vulg: ut probetis potiora ut sitis sinceres et sine offensa in diem Christi
clem: ut probetis potiora, ut sitis sinceri, et sine offensa in diem Christi,
tr: εις το δοκιμαζειν υμας τα διαφεροντα ινα ητε ειλικρινεις και απροσκοποι εις ημεραν χριστου
kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.

vulg: repleti fructu iustitiae per Christum Iesum in gloriam et laudem Dei
clem: repleti fructu justiti per Jesum Christum, in gloriam et laudem Dei.
tr: πεπληρωμενοι καρπων δικαιοσυνης των δια ιησου χριστου εις δοξαν και επαινον θεου
kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

vulg: scire autem vos volo fratres quia quae circa me sunt magis ad profectum venerunt evangelii
clem: Scire autem vos volo fratres, quia qu circa me sunt, magis ad profectum venerunt Evangelii:
tr: γινωσκειν δε υμας βουλομαι αδελφοι οτι τα κατ εμε μαλλον εις προκοπην του ευαγγελιου εληλυθεν
kjv: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

vulg: ita ut vincula mea manifesta fierent in Christo in omni praetorio et in ceteris omnibus
clem: ita ut vincula mea manifesta fierent in Christo in omni prtorio, et in ceteris omnibus,
tr: ωστε τους δεσμους μου φανερους εν χριστω γενεσθαι εν ολω τω πραιτωριω και τοις λοιποις πασιν
kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

vulg: et plures e fratribus in Domino confidentes vinculis meis abundantius audere sine timore verbum Dei loqui
clem: et plures e fratribus in Domino confidentes vinculis meis, abundantius auderent sine timore verbum Dei loqui.
tr: και τους πλειονας των αδελφων εν κυριω πεποιθοτας τοις δεσμοις μου περισσοτερως τολμαν αφοβως τον λογον λαλειν
kjv: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

vulg: quidam quidem et propter invidiam et contentionem quidam autem et propter bonam voluntatem Christum praedicant
clem: Quidam quidem et propter invidiam et contentionem: quidam autem et propter bonam voluntatem Christum prdicant:
tr: τινες μεν και δια φθονον και εριν τινες δε και δι ευδοκιαν τον χριστον κηρυσσουσιν
kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

vulg: quidam ex caritate scientes quoniam in defensionem evangelii positus sum
clem: quidam ex caritate, scientes quoniam in defensionem Evangelii positus sum.
tr: οι μεν εξ εριθειας τον χριστον καταγγελλουσιν ουχ αγνως οιομενοι θλιψιν επιφερειν τοις δεσμοις μου
kjv: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

vulg: quidam autem ex contentione Christum adnuntiant non sincere existimantes pressuram se suscitare vinculis meis
clem: Quidam autem ex contentione Christum annuntiant non sincere, existimantes pressuram se suscitare vinculis meis.
tr: οι δε εξ αγαπης ειδοτες οτι εις απολογιαν του ευαγγελιου κειμαι
kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

vulg: quid enim dum omni modo sive per occasionem sive per veritatem Christus adnuntiatur et in hoc gaudeo sed et gaudebo
clem: Quid enim? Dum omni modo sive per occasionem, sive per veritatem, Christus annuntietur: et in hoc gaudeo, sed et gaudebo.
tr: τι γαρ πλην παντι τροπω ειτε προφασει ειτε αληθεια χριστος καταγγελλεται και εν τουτω χαιρω αλλα και χαρησομαι
kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

vulg: scio enim quia hoc mihi proveniet in salutem per vestram orationem et subministrationem Spiritus Iesu Christi
clem: Scio enim quia hoc mihi proveniet ad salutem, per vestram orationem, et subministrationem Spiritus Jesu Christi,
tr: οιδα γαρ οτι τουτο μοι αποβησεται εις σωτηριαν δια της υμων δεησεως και επιχορηγιας του πνευματος ιησου χριστου
kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

vulg: secundum expectationem et spem meam quia in nullo confundar sed in omni fiducia sicut semper et nunc magnificabitur Christus in corpore meo sive per vitam sive per mortem
clem: secundum exspectationem et spem meam, quia in nullo confundar: sed in omni fiducia sicut semper, et nunc magnificabitur Christus in corpore meo, sive per vitam, sive per mortem.
tr: κατα την αποκαραδοκιαν και ελπιδα μου οτι εν ουδενι αισχυνθησομαι αλλ εν παση παρρησια ως παντοτε και νυν μεγαλυνθησεται χριστος εν τω σωματι μου ειτε δια ζωης ειτε δια θανατου
kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

vulg: mihi enim vivere Christus est et mori lucrum
clem: Mihi enim vivere Christus est, et mori lucrum.
tr: εμοι γαρ το ζην χριστος και το αποθανειν κερδος
kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

vulg: quod si vivere in carne hic mihi fructus operis est et quid eligam ignoro
clem: Quod si vivere in carne, hic mihi fructus operis est, et quid eligam ignoro.
tr: ει δε το ζην εν σαρκι τουτο μοι καρπος εργου και τι αιρησομαι ου γνωριζω
kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

vulg: coartor autem e duobus desiderium habens dissolvi et cum Christo esse multo magis melius
clem: Coarctor autem e duobus: desiderium habens dissolvi, et esse cum Christo, multo magis melius:
tr: συνεχομαι γαρ εκ των δυο την επιθυμιαν εχων εις το αναλυσαι και συν χριστω ειναι πολλω μαλλον κρεισσον
kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

vulg: permanere autem in carne magis necessarium est propter vos
clem: permanere autem in carne, necessarium propter vos.
tr: το δε επιμενειν εν τη σαρκι αναγκαιοτερον δι υμας
kjv: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

vulg: et hoc confidens scio quia manebo et permanebo omnibus vobis ad profectum vestrum et gaudium fidei
clem: Et hoc confidens scio quia manebo, et permanebo omnibus vobis ad profectum vestrum, et gaudium fidei:
tr: και τουτο πεποιθως οιδα οτι μενω και συμπαραμενω πασιν υμιν εις την υμων προκοπην και χαραν της πιστεως
kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

vulg: ut gratulatio vestra abundet in Christo Iesu in me per meum adventum iterum ad vos
clem: ut gratulatio vestra abundet in Christo Jesu in me, per meum adventum iterum ad vos.
tr: ινα το καυχημα υμων περισσευη εν χριστω ιησου εν εμοι δια της εμης παρουσιας παλιν προς υμας
kjv: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

vulg: tantum digne evangelio Christi conversamini ut sive cum venero et videro vos sive absens audiam de vobis quia stetistis uno spiritu unianimes conlaborantes fide evangelii
clem: Tantum digne Evangelio Christi conversamini: ut sive cum venero, et videro vos, sive absens audiam de vobis, quia statis in uno spiritu unanimes, collaborantes fidei Evangelii:
tr: μονον αξιως του ευαγγελιου του χριστου πολιτευεσθε ινα ειτε ελθων και ιδων υμας ειτε απων ακουσω τα περι υμων οτι στηκετε εν ενι πνευματι μια ψυχη συναθλουντες τη πιστει του ευαγγελιου
kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

vulg: et in nullo terreamini ab adversariis quae est illis causa perditionis vobis autem salutis et hoc a Deo
clem: et in nullo terreamini ab adversariis: qu illis est causa perditionis, vobis autem salutis, et hoc a Deo:
tr: και μη πτυρομενοι εν μηδενι υπο των αντικειμενων ητις αυτοις μεν εστιν ενδειξις απωλειας υμιν δε σωτηριας και τουτο απο θεου
kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

vulg: quia vobis donatum est pro Christo non solum ut in eum credatis sed ut etiam pro illo patiamini
clem: quia vobis donatum est pro Christo, non solum ut in eum credatis, sed ut etiam pro illo patiamini:
tr: οτι υμιν εχαρισθη το υπερ χριστου ου μονον το εις αυτον πιστευειν αλλα και το υπερ αυτου πασχειν
kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

vulg: eundem certamen habentes qualem et vidistis in me et nunc audistis de me
clem: idem certamen habentes, quale et vidistis in me, et nunc audistis de me.
tr: τον αυτον αγωνα εχοντες οιον ιδετε  ειδετε  εν εμοι και νυν ακουετε εν εμοι
kjv: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

vulg: si qua ergo consolatio in Christo si quod solacium caritatis si qua societas spiritus si quid viscera et miserationes
clem: Si qua ergo consolatio in Christo, si quod solatium caritatis, si qua societas spiritus, si qua viscera miserationis:
tr: ει τις ουν παρακλησις εν χριστω ει τι παραμυθιον αγαπης ει τις κοινωνια πνευματος ει τινα σπλαγχνα και οικτιρμοι
kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

vulg: implete gaudium meum ut idem sapiatis eandem caritatem habentes unianimes id ipsum sentientes
clem: implete gaudium meum ut idem sapiatis, eamdem caritatem habentes, unanimes, idipsum sentientes,
tr: πληρωσατε μου την χαραν ινα το αυτο φρονητε την αυτην αγαπην εχοντες συμψυχοι το εν φρονουντες
kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

vulg: nihil per contentionem neque per inanem gloriam sed in humilitate superiores sibi invicem arbitrantes
clem: nihil per contentionem, neque per inanem gloriam: sed in humilitate superiores sibi invicem arbitrantes,
tr: μηδεν κατα εριθειαν η κενοδοξιαν αλλα τη ταπεινοφροσυνη αλληλους ηγουμενοι υπερεχοντας εαυτων
kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

vulg: non quae sua sunt singuli considerantes sed et ea quae aliorum
clem: non qu sua sunt singuli considerantes, sed ea qu aliorum.
tr: μη τα εαυτων εκαστος σκοπειτε αλλα και τα ετερων εκαστος
kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

vulg: hoc enim sentite in vobis quod et in Christo Iesu
clem: Hoc enim sentite in vobis, quod et in Christo Jesu:
tr: τουτο γαρ φρονεισθω εν υμιν ο και εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

vulg: qui cum in forma Dei esset non rapinam arbitratus est esse se aequalem Deo
clem: qui cum in forma Dei esset, non rapinam arbitratus est esse se qualem Deo:
tr: ος εν μορφη θεου υπαρχων ουχ αρπαγμον ηγησατο το ειναι ισα θεω
kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

vulg: sed semet ipsum exinanivit formam servi accipiens in similitudinem hominum factus et habitu inventus ut homo
clem: sed semetipsum exinanivit, formam servi accipiens, in similitudinem hominum factus, et habitu inventus ut homo.
tr: αλλ εαυτον εκενωσεν μορφην δουλου λαβων εν ομοιωματι ανθρωπων γενομενος
kjv: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

vulg: humiliavit semet ipsum factus oboediens usque ad mortem mortem autem crucis
clem: Humiliavit semetipsum factus obediens usque ad mortem, mortem autem crucis.
tr: και σχηματι ευρεθεις ως ανθρωπος εταπεινωσεν εαυτον γενομενος υπηκοος μεχρι θανατου θανατου δε σταυρου
kjv: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

vulg: propter quod et Deus illum exaltavit et donavit illi nomen super omne nomen
clem: Propter quod et Deus exaltavit illum, et donavit illi nomen, quod est super omne nomen:
tr: διο και ο θεος αυτον υπερυψωσεν και εχαρισατο αυτω ονομα το υπερ παν ονομα
kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

vulg: ut in nomine Iesu omne genu flectat caelestium et terrestrium et infernorum
clem: ut in nomine Jesu omne genu flectatur clestium, terrestrium et infernorum,
tr: ινα εν τω ονοματι ιησου παν γονυ καμψη επουρανιων και επιγειων και καταχθονιων
kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

vulg: et omnis lingua confiteatur quia Dominus Iesus Christus in gloria est Dei Patris
clem: et omnis lingua confiteatur, quia Dominus Jesus Christus in gloria est Dei Patris.
tr: και πασα γλωσσα εξομολογησηται οτι κυριος ιησους χριστος εις δοξαν θεου πατρος
kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

vulg: itaque carissimi mei sicut semper oboedistis non ut in praesentia mei tantum sed multo magis nunc in absentia mea cum metu et tremore vestram salutem operamini
clem: Itaque carissimi mei (sicut semper obedistis), non ut in prsentia mei tantum, sed multo magis nunc in absentia mea, cum metu et tremore vestram salutem operamini.
tr: ωστε αγαπητοι μου καθως παντοτε υπηκουσατε μη ως εν τη παρουσια μου μονον αλλα νυν πολλω μαλλον εν τη απουσια μου μετα φοβου και τρομου την εαυτων σωτηριαν κατεργαζεσθε
kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

vulg: Deus est enim qui operatur in vobis et velle et perficere pro bona voluntate
clem: Deus est enim, qui operatur in vobis et velle, et perficere pro bona voluntate.
tr: ο θεος γαρ εστιν ο ενεργων εν υμιν και το θελειν και το ενεργειν υπερ της ευδοκιας
kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

vulg: omnia autem facite sine murmurationibus et haesitationibus
clem: Omnia autem facite sine murmurationibus et hsitationibus:
tr: παντα ποιειτε χωρις γογγυσμων και διαλογισμων
kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

vulg: ut sitis sine querella et simplices filii Dei sine reprehensione in medio nationis pravae et perversae inter quos lucetis sicut luminaria in mundo
clem: ut sitis sine querela, et simplices filii Dei, sine reprehensione in medio nationis prav et pervers: inter quos lucetis sicut luminaria in mundo,
tr: ινα γενησθε αμεμπτοι και ακεραιοι τεκνα θεου αμωμητα εν μεσω γενεας σκολιας και διεστραμμενης εν οις φαινεσθε ως φωστηρες εν κοσμω
kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

vulg: verbum vitae continentes ad gloriam meam in die Christi quia non in vacuum cucurri neque in vacuum laboravi
clem: verbum vit continentes ad gloriam meam in die Christi, quia non in vacuum cucurri, neque in vacuum laboravi.
tr: λογον ζωης επεχοντες εις καυχημα εμοι εις ημεραν χριστου οτι ουκ εις κενον εδραμον ουδε εις κενον εκοπιασα
kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

vulg: sed et si immolor supra sacrificium et obsequium fidei vestrae gaudeo et congratulor omnibus vobis
clem: Sed et si immolor supra sacrificium, et obsequium fidei vestr, gaudeo, et congratulor omnibus vobis.
tr: αλλ ει και σπενδομαι επι τη θυσια και λειτουργια της πιστεως υμων χαιρω και συγχαιρω πασιν υμιν
kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

vulg: id ipsum autem et vos gaudete et congratulamini mihi
clem: Idipsum autem et vos gaudete, et congratulamini mihi.
tr: το δ αυτο και υμεις χαιρετε και συγχαιρετε μοι
kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

vulg: spero autem in Domino Iesu Timotheum cito me mittere ad vos ut et ego bono animo sim cognitis quae circa vos sunt
clem: Spero autem in Domino Jesu, Timotheum me cito mittere ad vos: ut et ego bono animo sim, cognitis qu circa vos sunt.
tr: ελπιζω δε εν κυριω ιησου τιμοθεον ταχεως πεμψαι υμιν ινα καγω ευψυχω γνους τα περι υμων
kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

vulg: neminem enim habeo tam unianimem qui sincera affectione pro vobis sollicitus sit
clem: Neminem enim habeo tam unanimem, qui sincera affectione pro vobis sollicitus sit.
tr: ουδενα γαρ εχω ισοψυχον οστις γνησιως τα περι υμων μεριμνησει
kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

vulg: omnes enim sua quaerunt non quae sunt Christi Iesu
clem: Omnes enim qu sua sunt qurunt, non qu sunt Jesu Christi.
tr: οι παντες γαρ τα εαυτων ζητουσιν ου τα του χριστου ιησου
kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.

vulg: experimentum autem eius cognoscite quoniam sicut patri filius mecum servivit in evangelium
clem: Experimentum autem ejus cognoscite, quia sicut patri filius, mecum servivit in Evangelio.
tr: την δε δοκιμην αυτου γινωσκετε οτι ως πατρι τεκνον συν εμοι εδουλευσεν εις το ευαγγελιον
kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

vulg: hunc igitur spero me mittere mox ut videro quae circa me sunt
clem: Hunc igitur spero me mittere ad vos, mox ut videro qu circa me sunt.
tr: τουτον μεν ουν ελπιζω πεμψαι ως αν απιδω τα περι εμε εξαυτης
kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

vulg: confido autem in Domino quoniam et ipse veniam ad vos cito
clem: Confido autem in Domino quoniam et ipse veniam ad vos cito.
tr: πεποιθα δε εν κυριω οτι και αυτος ταχεως ελευσομαι
kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

vulg: necessarium autem existimavi Epafroditum fratrem et cooperatorem et commilitonem meum vestrum autem apostolum et ministrum necessitatis meae mittere ad vos
clem: Necessarium autem existimavi Epaphroditum fratrem, et cooperatorem, et commilitonem meum, vestrum autem apostolum, et ministrum necessitatis me, mittere ad vos:
tr: αναγκαιον δε ηγησαμην επαφροδιτον τον αδελφον και συνεργον και συστρατιωτην μου υμων δε αποστολον και λειτουργον της χρειας μου πεμψαι προς υμας
kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

vulg: quoniam quidem omnes vos desiderabat et maestus erat propterea quod audieratis illum infirmatum
clem: quoniam quidem omnes vos desiderabat: et mstus erat, propterea quod audieratis illum infirmatum.
tr: επειδη επιποθων ην παντας υμας και αδημονων διοτι ηκουσατε οτι ησθενησεν
kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

vulg: nam et infirmatus est usque ad mortem sed Deus misertus est eius non solum autem eius verum etiam et mei ne tristitiam super tristitiam haberem
clem: Nam et infirmatus est usque ad mortem: sed Deus misertus est ejus: non solum autem ejus, verum etiam et mei, ne tristitiam super tristitiam haberem.
tr: και γαρ ησθενησεν παραπλησιον θανατω αλλ ο θεος αυτον ηλεησεν ουκ αυτον δε μονον αλλα και εμε ινα μη λυπην επι λυπη σχω
kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

vulg: festinantius ergo misi illum ut viso eo iterum gaudeatis et ego sine tristitia sim
clem: Festinantius ergo misi illum, ut viso eo iterum gaudeatis, et ego sine tristitia sim.
tr: σπουδαιοτερως ουν επεμψα αυτον ινα ιδοντες αυτον παλιν χαρητε καγω αλυποτερος ω
kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

vulg: excipite itaque illum cum omni gaudio in Domino et eiusmodi cum honore habetote
clem: Excipite itaque illum cum omni gaudio in Domino, et ejusmodi cum honore habetote;
tr: προσδεχεσθε ουν αυτον εν κυριω μετα πασης χαρας και τους τοιουτους εντιμους εχετε
kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

vulg: quoniam propter opus Christi usque ad mortem accessit tradens animam suam ut impleret id quod ex vobis deerat erga meum obsequium
clem: quoniam propter opus Christi usque ad mortem accessit, tradens animam suam ut impleret id quod ex vobis deerat erga meum obsequium.
tr: οτι δια το εργον του χριστου μεχρι θανατου ηγγισεν παραβουλευσαμενος τη ψυχη ινα αναπληρωση το υμων υστερημα της προς με λειτουργιας
kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

vulg: de cetero fratres mei gaudete in Domino eadem vobis scribere mihi quidem non pigrum vobis autem necessarium
clem: De cetero, fratres mei, gaudete in Domino. Eadem vobis scribere, mihi quidem non pigrum, vobis autem necessarium.
tr: το λοιπον αδελφοι μου χαιρετε εν κυριω τα αυτα γραφειν υμιν εμοι μεν ουκ οκνηρον υμιν δε ασφαλες
kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

vulg: videte canes videte malos operarios videte concisionem
clem: Videte canes, videte malos operarios, videte concisionem.
tr: βλεπετε τους κυνας βλεπετε τους κακους εργατας βλεπετε την κατατομην
kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

vulg: nos enim sumus circumcisio qui spiritu Deo servimus et gloriamur in Christo Iesu et non in carne fiduciam habentes
clem: Nos enim sumus circumcisio, qui spiritu servimus Deo, et gloriamur in Christo Jesu, et non in carne fiduciam habentes,
tr: ημεις γαρ εσμεν η περιτομη οι πνευματι θεω λατρευοντες και καυχωμενοι εν χριστω ιησου και ουκ εν σαρκι πεποιθοτες
kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

vulg: quamquam ego habeam confidentiam et in carne si quis alius videtur confidere in carne ego magis
clem: quamquam ego habeam confidentiam et in carne. Si quis alius videtur confidere in carne, ego magis,
tr: καιπερ εγω εχων πεποιθησιν και εν σαρκι ει τις δοκει αλλος πεποιθεναι εν σαρκι εγω μαλλον
kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

vulg: circumcisus octava die ex genere Israhel de tribu Beniamin Hebraeus ex Hebraeis secundum legem Pharisaeus
clem: circumcisus octavo die, ex genere Isral, de tribu Benjamin, Hebrus ex Hebris, secundum legem pharisus,
tr: περιτομη οκταημερος εκ γενους ισραηλ φυλης βενιαμιν εβραιος εξ εβραιων κατα νομον φαρισαιος
kjv: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

vulg: secundum aemulationem persequens ecclesiam Dei secundum iustitiam quae in lege est conversatus sine querella
clem: secundum mulationem persequens Ecclesiam Dei, secundum justitiam, qu in lege est, conversatus sine querela.
tr: κατα ζηλον διωκων την εκκλησιαν κατα δικαιοσυνην την εν νομω γενομενος αμεμπτος
kjv: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

vulg: sed quae mihi fuerunt lucra haec arbitratus sum propter Christum detrimenta
clem: Sed qu mihi fuerunt lucra, hc arbitratus sum propter Christum detrimenta.
tr: αλλ ατινα ην μοι κερδη ταυτα ηγημαι δια τον χριστον ζημιαν
kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

vulg: verumtamen existimo omnia detrimentum esse propter eminentem scientiam Iesu Christi Domini mei propter quem omnia detrimentum feci et arbitror ut stercora ut Christum lucri faciam
clem: Verumtamen existimo omnia detrimentum esse propter eminentem scientiam Jesu Christi Domini mei: propter quem omnia detrimentum feci, et arbitror ut stercora, ut Christum lucrifaciam,
tr: αλλα μενουνγε και ηγουμαι παντα ζημιαν ειναι δια το υπερεχον της γνωσεως χριστου ιησου του κυριου μου δι ον τα παντα εζημιωθην και ηγουμαι σκυβαλα ειναι ινα χριστον κερδησω
kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

vulg: et inveniar in illo non habens meam iustitiam quae ex lege est sed illam quae ex fide est Christi quae ex Deo est iustitia in fide
clem: et inveniar in illo non habens meam justitiam, qu ex lege est, sed illam, qu ex fide est Christi Jesu: qu ex Deo est justitia in fide,
tr: και ευρεθω εν αυτω μη εχων εμην δικαιοσυνην την εκ νομου αλλα την δια πιστεως χριστου την εκ θεου δικαιοσυνην επι τη πιστει
kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

vulg: ad agnoscendum illum et virtutem resurrectionis eius et societatem passionum illius configuratus morti eius
clem: ad cognoscendum illum, et virtutem resurrectionis ejus, et societatem passionum illius: configuratus morti ejus:
tr: του γνωναι αυτον και την δυναμιν της αναστασεως αυτου και την κοινωνιαν των παθηματων αυτου συμμορφουμενος τω θανατω αυτου
kjv: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

vulg: si quo modo occurram ad resurrectionem quae est ex mortuis
clem: si quo modo occurram ad resurrectionem, qu est ex mortuis:
tr: ει πως καταντησω εις την εξαναστασιν των νεκρων
kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

vulg: non quod iam acceperim aut iam perfectus sim sequor autem si conprehendam in quo et conprehensus sum a Christo Iesu
clem: non quod jam acceperim, aut jam perfectus sim: sequor autem, si quomodo comprehendam in quo et comprehensus sum a Christo Jesu.
tr: ουχ οτι ηδη ελαβον η ηδη τετελειωμαι διωκω δε ει και καταλαβω εφ ω και κατεληφθην υπο του χριστου ιησου
kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

vulg: fratres ego me non arbitror conprehendisse unum autem quae quidem retro sunt obliviscens ad ea vero quae sunt in priora extendens me
clem: Fratres, ego me non arbitror comprehendisse. Unum autem, qu quidem retro sunt obliviscens, ad ea vero qu sunt priora, extendens meipsum,
tr: αδελφοι εγω εμαυτον ου λογιζομαι κατειληφεναι εν δε τα μεν οπισω επιλανθανομενος τοις δε εμπροσθεν επεκτεινομενος
kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

vulg: ad destinatum persequor ad bravium supernae vocationis Dei in Christo Iesu
clem: ad destinatum persequor, ad bravium supern vocationis Dei in Christo Jesu.
tr: κατα σκοπον διωκω επι το βραβειον της ανω κλησεως του θεου εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

vulg: quicumque ergo perfecti hoc sentiamus et si quid aliter sapitis et hoc vobis Deus revelabit
clem: Quicumque ergo perfecti sumus, hoc sentiamus: et si quid aliter sapitis, et hoc vobis Deus revelabit.
tr: οσοι ουν τελειοι τουτο φρονωμεν και ει τι ετερως φρονειτε και τουτο ο θεος υμιν αποκαλυψει
kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

vulg: verumtamen ad quod pervenimus ut idem sapiamus et in eadem permaneamus regula
clem: Verumtamen ad quod pervenimus ut idem sapiamus, et in eadem permaneamus regula.
tr: πλην εις ο εφθασαμεν τω αυτω στοιχειν κανονι το αυτο φρονειν
kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

vulg: imitatores mei estote fratres et observate eos qui ita ambulant sicut habetis formam nos
clem: Imitatores mei estote, fratres, et observate eos qui ita ambulant, sicut habetis formam nostram.
tr: συμμιμηται μου γινεσθε αδελφοι και σκοπειτε τους ουτως περιπατουντας καθως εχετε τυπον ημας
kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

vulg: multi enim ambulant quos saepe dicebam vobis nunc autem et flens dico inimicos crucis Christi
clem: Multi enim ambulant, quos spe dicebam vobis (nunc autem et flens dico) inimicos crucis Christi:
tr: πολλοι γαρ περιπατουσιν ους πολλακις ελεγον υμιν νυν δε και κλαιων λεγω τους εχθρους του σταυρου του χριστου
kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

vulg: quorum finis interitus quorum deus venter et gloria in confusione ipsorum qui terrena sapiunt
clem: quorum finis interitus: quorum Deus venter est: et gloria in confusione ipsorum, qui terrena sapiunt.
tr: ων το τελος απωλεια ων ο θεος η κοιλια και η δοξα εν τη αισχυνη αυτων οι τα επιγεια φρονουντες
kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

vulg: nostra autem conversatio in caelis est unde etiam salvatorem expectamus Dominum Iesum Christum
clem: Nostra autem conversatio in clis est: unde etiam Salvatorem exspectamus Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
tr: ημων γαρ το πολιτευμα εν ουρανοις υπαρχει εξ ου και σωτηρα απεκδεχομεθα κυριον ιησουν χριστον
kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

vulg: qui reformabit corpus humilitatis nostrae configuratum corpori claritatis suae secundum operationem qua possit etiam subicere sibi omnia
clem: qui reformabit corpus humilitatis nostr, configuratum corpori claritatis su, secundum operationem, qua etiam possit subjicere sibi omnia.
tr: ος μετασχηματισει το σωμα της ταπεινωσεως ημων εις το γενεσθαι αυτο συμμορφον τω σωματι της δοξης αυτου κατα την ενεργειαν του δυνασθαι αυτον και υποταξαι εαυτω τα παντα
kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

vulg: itaque fratres mei carissimi et desiderantissimi gaudium meum et corona mea sic state in Domino carissimi
clem: Itaque fratres mei carissimi, et desideratissimi, gaudium meum, et corona mea: sic state in Domino, carissimi.
tr: ωστε αδελφοι μου αγαπητοι και επιποθητοι χαρα και στεφανος μου ουτως στηκετε εν κυριω αγαπητοι
kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

vulg: Euhodiam rogo et Syntychen deprecor id ipsum sapere in Domino
clem: Evodiam rogo, et Syntychen deprecor, idipsum sapere in Domino.
tr: ευωδιαν  ευοδιαν  παρακαλω και συντυχην παρακαλω το αυτο φρονειν εν κυριω
kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

vulg: etiam rogo et te germane conpar adiuva illas quae mecum laboraverunt in evangelio cum Clemente et ceteris adiutoribus meis quorum nomina sunt in libro vitae
clem: Etiam rogo et te, germane compar, adjuva illas, qu mecum laboraverunt in Evangelio cum Clemente, et ceteris adjutoribus meis, quorum nomina sunt in libro vit.
tr: και ερωτω και σε συζυγε γνησιε συλλαμβανου αυταις αιτινες εν τω ευαγγελιω συνηθλησαν μοι μετα και κλημεντος και των λοιπων συνεργων μου ων τα ονοματα εν βιβλω ζωης
kjv: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

vulg: gaudete in Domino semper iterum dico gaudete
clem: Gaudete in Domino semper: iterum dico gaudete.
tr: χαιρετε εν κυριω παντοτε παλιν ερω χαιρετε
kjv: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.

vulg: modestia vestra nota sit omnibus hominibus Dominus prope
clem: Modestia vestra nota sit omnibus hominibus: Dominus prope est.
tr: το επιεικες υμων γνωσθητω πασιν ανθρωποις ο κυριος εγγυς
kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

vulg: nihil solliciti sitis sed in omni oratione et obsecratione cum gratiarum actione petitiones vestrae innotescant apud Deum
clem: Nihil solliciti sitis: sed in omni oratione, et obsecratione, cum gratiarum actione petitiones vestr innotescant apud Deum.
tr: μηδεν μεριμνατε αλλ εν παντι τη προσευχη και τη δεησει μετα ευχαριστιας τα αιτηματα υμων γνωριζεσθω προς τον θεον
kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

vulg: et pax Dei quae exsuperat omnem sensum custodiat corda vestra et intellegentias vestras in Christo Iesu
clem: Et pax Dei, qu exuperat omnem sensum, custodiat corda vestra, et intelligentias vestras in Christo Jesu.
tr: και η ειρηνη του θεου η υπερεχουσα παντα νουν φρουρησει τας καρδιας υμων και τα νοηματα υμων εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

vulg: de cetero fratres quaecumque sunt vera quaecumque pudica quaecumque iusta quaecumque sancta quaecumque amabilia quaecumque bonae famae si qua virtus si qua laus haec cogitate
clem: De cetero fratres, qucumque sunt vera, qucumque pudica, qucumque justa, qucumque sancta, qucumque amabilia, qucumque bon fam, siqua virtus, siqua laus disciplin, hc cogitate.
tr: το λοιπον αδελφοι οσα εστιν αληθη οσα σεμνα οσα δικαια οσα αγνα οσα προσφιλη οσα ευφημα ει τις αρετη και ει τις επαινος ταυτα λογιζεσθε
kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

vulg: quae et didicistis et accepistis et audistis et vidistis in me haec agite et Deus pacis erit vobiscum
clem: Qu et didicistis, et accepistis, et audistis, et vidistis in me, hc agite: et Deus pacis erit vobiscum.
tr: α και εμαθετε και παρελαβετε και ηκουσατε και ειδετε εν εμοι ταυτα πρασσετε και ο θεος της ειρηνης εσται μεθ υμων
kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

vulg: gavisus sum autem in Domino vehementer quoniam tandem aliquando refloruistis pro me sentire sicut et sentiebatis occupati autem eratis
clem: Gavisus sum autem in Domino vehementer, quoniam tandem aliquando refloruistis pro me sentire, sicut et sentiebatis: occupati autem eratis.
tr: εχαρην δε εν κυριω μεγαλως οτι ηδη ποτε ανεθαλετε το υπερ εμου φρονειν εφ ω και εφρονειτε ηκαιρεισθε δε
kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

vulg: non quasi propter penuriam dico ego enim didici in quibus sum sufficiens esse
clem: Non quasi propter penuriam dico: ego enim didici, in quibus sum, sufficiens esse.
tr: ουχ οτι καθ υστερησιν λεγω εγω γαρ εμαθον εν οις ειμι αυταρκης ειναι
kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

vulg: scio et humiliari scio et abundare ubique et in omnibus institutus sum et satiari et esurire et abundare et penuriam pati
clem: Scio et humiliari, scio et abundare (ubique et in omnibus institutus sum): et satiari, et esurire, et abundare, et penuriam pati.
tr: οιδα δε  και  ταπεινουσθαι οιδα και περισσευειν εν παντι και εν πασιν μεμυημαι και χορταζεσθαι και πειναν και περισσευειν και υστερεισθαι
kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

vulg: omnia possum in eo qui me confortat
clem: Omnia possum in eo qui me confortat.
tr: παντα ισχυω εν τω ενδυναμουντι με χριστω
kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

vulg: verumtamen bene fecistis communicantes tribulationi meae
clem: Verumtamen bene fecistis, communicantes tribulationi me.
tr: πλην καλως εποιησατε συγκοινωνησαντες μου τη θλιψει
kjv: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

vulg: scitis autem et vos Philippenses quod in principio evangelii quando profectus sum a Macedonia nulla mihi ecclesia communicavit in ratione dati et accepti nisi vos soli
clem: Scitis autem et vos Philippenses, quod in principio Evangelii, quando profectus sum a Macedonia, nulla mihi ecclesia communicavit in ratione dati et accepti, nisi vos soli:
tr: οιδατε δε και υμεις φιλιππησιοι οτι εν αρχη του ευαγγελιου οτε εξηλθον απο μακεδονιας ουδεμια μοι εκκλησια εκοινωνησεν εις λογον δοσεως και ληψεως ει μη υμεις μονοι
kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

vulg: quia et Thessalonicam et semel et bis in usum mihi misistis
clem: quia et Thessalonicam semel et bis in usum mihi misistis.
tr: οτι και εν θεσσαλονικη και απαξ και δις εις την χρειαν μοι επεμψατε
kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

vulg: non quia quaero datum sed requiro fructum abundantem in rationem vestram
clem: Non quia quro datum, sed requiro fructum abundantem in ratione vestra.
tr: ουχ οτι επιζητω το δομα αλλ επιζητω τον καρπον τον πλεοναζοντα εις λογον υμων
kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

vulg: habeo autem omnia et abundo repletus sum acceptis ab Epafrodito quae misistis odorem suavitatis hostiam acceptam placentem Deo
clem: Habeo autem omnia, et abundo: repletus sum, acceptis ab Epaphrodito qu misistis odorem suavitatis, hostiam acceptam, placentem Deo.
tr: απεχω δε παντα και περισσευω πεπληρωμαι δεξαμενος παρα επαφροδιτου τα παρ υμων οσμην ευωδιας θυσιαν δεκτην ευαρεστον τω θεω
kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

vulg: Deus autem meus impleat omne desiderium vestrum secundum divitias suas in gloria in Christo Iesu
clem: Deus autem meus impleat omne desiderium vestrum secundum divitias suas in gloria in Christo Jesu.
tr: ο δε θεος μου πληρωσει πασαν χρειαν υμων κατα τον πλουτον αυτου εν δοξη εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

vulg: Deo autem et Patri nostro gloria in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: Deo autem et Patri nostro gloria in scula sculorum. Amen.
tr: τω δε θεω και πατρι ημων η δοξα εις τους αιωνας των αιωνων αμην
kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

vulg: salutate omnem sanctum in Christo Iesu salutant vos qui mecum sunt fratres
clem: Salutate omnem sanctum in Christo Jesu.
tr: ασπασασθε παντα αγιον εν χριστω ιησου ασπαζονται υμας οι συν εμοι αδελφοι
kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

vulg: salutant vos omnes sancti maxime autem qui de Caesaris domo sunt
clem: Salutant vos, qui mecum sunt, fratres. Salutant vos omnes sancti, maxime autem qui de Csaris domo sunt.
tr: ασπαζονται υμας παντες οι αγιοι μαλιστα δε οι εκ της καισαρος οικιας
kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.

vulg: gratia Domini Iesu Christi cum spiritu vestro amen
clem: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum spiritu vestro. Amen.
tr: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων υμων αμην [ προς φιλιππησιους εγραφη απο ρωμης δι επαφροδιτου]
kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
